purpose: 交互概念图；未接入游戏；基础符保留方案
prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE landscape interaction concept board with THREE large portrait mobile game screens, arranged left to right, with concise Chinese captions on cream paper margins. STYLE REFERENCE image: existing Chinese folk papercut game. Preserve huge red sun, ivory sky, layered angular vermilion mountains, charcoal battlefield, little white fox with red markings fixed near lower center, black-red cut-paper demons, antique gold accents, paper fibers and articulated folds. Reference is style only, not edit target. Simplify UI: top slim health and ink bars; bottom persistent small base gesture strip with EXACT labels "一字斩" "护圆" "三角", and ONE distinctive special paper tab above it. No old developer buttons, no skill level selectors. Show actual screen interaction, tiny gold fingertip dot and slightly irregular red input stroke; no realistic hands, no photorealism, no 3D, no full-screen explosions hiding mechanics. Each panel must show same fox and spatially consistent battlefield. Muted pale-gold dashed marks = suggested input; cinnabar line = actual player stroke. Preview semi-transparent; committed result opaque. Prioritize readable action and change, not promotional spectacle. Title and each step caption large and legible. Title "方案 D · 红线缝妖". Three steps "① 选符 · 针孔亮起" "② 穿过敌人 · 红线预览" "③ 收线聚怪 · 一字斩". Panel1: special tab "红线符" selected red; three enemies spread left, center, right in upper battlefield each with small luminous gold needle-eye aperture on chest. One pale gold suggested route goes from aperture to aperture, unobtrusive. A compact temporary prompt "穿过针孔，松手收线"; show "取消" beside special tab. Panel2: gold fingertip at third target, visibly asymmetric winding red thread passes through first two needle eyes and third, attached targets visibly rimmed in gold; one extra unthreaded demon stays far upper-right. The actual thread must have a clear irregular path distinct from dashed suggestion, show "已连接 3". Panel3: all three threaded demons pulled together in a small cluster at thread centroid, red thread cinched around them; a fresh clear straight diagonal gold-white slash cuts the cluster, little white fox remains fixed. Bottom special tab no longer highlighted and "一字斩" subtly highlighted to indicate returned to normal input. The unthreaded fourth demon remains unmoved. Add footer "先自由穿线，再用原有斩击收尾". Show paper needle and red silk material, not laser cables. Important: no pretense of tracing a complicated glyph; player intentionally hits meaningful targets.

Panel1: a visibly damaged ivory-red paper crane lies on ground above-right of white fox, with ONE wing half missing; torn edge and faded tiny gold dashed outline clearly reveal exactly what is missing. Small localized label "按住缺口修补" and a gold start dot on wing-root, NO full-screen copybook, NO modal. Enemies remain further above. Panel2: close-enough framing but keep full portrait scene and same fox; gold fingertip draws ONE simple broad arc from wing root along missing wing outer contour; actual cinnabar stroke slightly uneven over pale dashed outline. As it progresses, triangular ivory paper wing sections visibly unfold into place behind the stroke, completed areas opaque and unfinished areas translucent; text "补上翅膀即可", no accuracy score. The rest of screen stays recognizable, base gestures muted ONLY during active repair touch. Panel3: same crane restored, actual red arc remains as wing ornament; crane unfolds and flies forward from repaired position, fanning a visibly broad paper-wind gust that pushes three nearby paper demons backward. Tiny label "修补完成"; base gestures restored bright. Footer "场景里的缺口，就是你的提示". Crane should be folded paper with flat ornamental cut-outs, not a realistic feathered bird. First panel must clearly show incomplete wing, second active reconstruction, third clear useful effect.
